purpose: Product-facing HD substitution contracts for synchronized ordinary-race racer objects.

lookup.note: The primary 16-bit presentation ID remains the lookup key. Exact composed-object guards are required because the visible 64x64 object can also depend on companion presentation, selector clipping, companion gating, palette and OAM orientation.

registration.orientation_policy: apply runtime OAM H/V flip after asset selection
registration.pivot_policy: use semantic_anchors.flip_pivot_x2_y2; apply runtime OAM H/V reflection after semantic selection
registration.contact_policy: use semantic_anchors.wheel_contact_x2_y2 as the stock registration target for independently drawn replacement art

semantic_anchors.flip_pivot_derivation: exact centre of the 64x64 OBJ reflection domain
semantic_anchors.wheel_contact_derivation: centre of the lowest occupied alpha span in the deterministic stock composed raster

registration.native_draw_status: ready through the accepted host draw-frame seam

original.scale_policy: nearest-neighbor only when a higher-density comparison surface is required

remastered_candidate.approval_status: contract-only candidate; not approved shipping art
remastered_candidate.intent: Provide a clearly provenance-labelled high-resolution substitute that preserves the source silhouette, palette, registration and transparency while exercising a non-nearest replacement path.
remastered_candidate.alpha_policy: Scale2x RGB candidate with final alpha locked to nearest-scaled Original coverage
remastered_candidate.contact_preservation: Exact stock alpha footprint at 4x density; object-local origin unchanged

entries.fallback: If replacement is disabled, missing, or composition guards do not match, render the deterministic Original asset.
